trials.trade_rules: ENTRY: copy only a FRESH leader buy (they did not already hold the coin; no adds/DCA) and only if coin MC is under $500k at our fill. Each trial starts with a $1,000 paper book. Ticket = 10% of the leader's buy in USD, capped at the trial book's available cash (never negative; skip if under $1). EXITS (whichever comes first): at ~2x, sell enough to recover the initial ticket (cost basis incl. fees) and hold the free remainder as a moonbag with a 40% trail from peak; a further own partial (1/3 of the moonbag) only at ~5x if still held; full exit if the leader fully sells out; existing -25% hard stop from entry. We do not mirror leader partial sells. PAPER ONLY.
